etymology.historical_story: Himura is attested in the official character material for Rurouni Kenshin as the surname of Kenshin Himura, a wandering swordsman whose story connects his violent past with a vow against killing. This establishes a cultural reference, but does not identify every occurrence of the name or establish a Malay lexical origin. [Official introduction](https://rurounikenshin-anime.com/story/intro.html)
